notice: Partial atlas. Source meshes and imported names are a technical inventory, not a count of complete or medically reviewed structures. No authored disease views or verified pathways are included.

systems.label: Skin / exterior

supplied.female: Exterior skin surface.
supplied.male: Exterior skin surface.

systems.gaps: A skin surface does not establish complete skin layers, microscopic tissue or local disease geometry.

systems.label: Skeleton

supplied.female: Pelvis and lower-limb source groups.
supplied.male: Pelvis, lower-limb source groups and a hyoid mesh.

systems.gaps: No skull, shoulder girdle or upper-limb skeleton in these samples; the spine (HRA v1.2) and the ribs and sternum (Visible Human CT) are listed separately. Regional completeness and small structures need review.

systems.label: Muscles

supplied.female: Eye and knee muscle groups.
supplied.male: Eye, knee and laryngeal muscle groups.

systems.gaps: No comprehensive superficial/deep whole-body muscle collection; the gluteal, iliopsoas and deep back muscles traced from the Visible Human CT are listed separately.

systems.label: Nervous anatomy

supplied.female: Brain and eye-related source geometry, including an Allen brain contribution.
supplied.male: Brain and eye-related source geometry, including an Allen brain contribution.

systems.gaps: These groups do not establish a whole-body peripheral nerve collection or a reviewed pathway graph.

systems.label: Heart / circulation

supplied.female: Heart component groups and blood-vessel source meshes.
supplied.male: Heart component groups and blood-vessel source meshes.

systems.gaps: Both hearts have 14 supplied component meshes. Cavity surfaces, completeness, clinical cutaways and source labels need review. Vessel proximity does not establish flow direction or connectivity.

systems.label: Lungs / respiratory anatomy

supplied.female: Left/right lung groups, regional meshes and tracheobronchial geometry.
supplied.male: Left/right lung groups, regional meshes and tracheobronchial geometry.

systems.gaps: Regional source meshes are not a complete or reviewed respiratory atlas. The separate Heart ↔ lungs study route remains an unreviewed conceptual guide. Pathological geometry is unavailable.

systems.label: Digestive anatomy

supplied.female: Colon, small intestine, biliary-tree, liver, pancreas and gallbladder groups.
supplied.male: Colon, small intestine, biliary-tree, liver, pancreas and gallbladder groups.

systems.gaps: Supplied organs do not establish all digestive structures, wall layers, interior surfaces or passage/connection pathways.

systems.label: Urinary anatomy

supplied.female: Kidney, ureter and urinary-bladder groups.
supplied.male: Kidney, ureter, urinary-bladder and urethra groups.

systems.gaps: Substructure completeness, interiors, correspondence and connection pathways remain unreviewed.

systems.label: Reproductive anatomy

supplied.female: Vagina, fallopian-tube, ligament, ovary and uterus source groups.
supplied.male: Male genital-duct and prostate source groups.

systems.gaps: The reference collections differ substantially. Their source groups are not evidence of complete reproductive anatomy or equivalent detail across bodies.

systems.label: Lymphatic anatomy

supplied.female: Spleen, thymus and a Yao lymph-node contribution.
supplied.male: Spleen, thymus and a Yao lymph-node contribution.

systems.gaps: A complete lymphatic vessel/node collection and reviewed routes are not established.

systems.label: Breasts (HRA v1.3)

supplied.female: Left and right mammary glands with lobes, fat, nipple, areola and areolar tubercles, appended from the HRA v1.3 release.
supplied.male: Not supplied: the HRA library has no male mammary model.

systems.gaps: Reference shapes only; no breast tissue states, lymphatics or disease geometry.

systems.label: Palatine tonsils (HRA v1.4)

supplied.female: Left and right palatine tonsils, appended from the HRA v1.4 release.
supplied.male: Left and right palatine tonsils, appended from the HRA v1.4 release.

systems.gaps: The pharyngeal tonsils (adenoids) and lingual tonsils are not supplied.

systems.label: Spinal cord (HRA v1.2)

supplied.female: Spinal cord segments, appended from the HRA v1.2 release.
supplied.male: Spinal cord segments, appended from the HRA v1.2 release.

systems.gaps: No spinal nerves, meninges or internal cord structure.

systems.label: Vertebrae (HRA v1.2)

supplied.female: Vertebrae, appended from the HRA v1.2 release.
supplied.male: Vertebrae, appended from the HRA v1.2 release.

systems.gaps: No intervertebral disks, spinal ligaments or back muscles in the HRA bodies; the complete male body supplies those.

systems.label: Parotid glands (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: Left and right parotid glands, traced from the Visible Human female CT and fitted to this body's eyes and neck vertebrae.
supplied.male: Left and right parotid glands, traced from the Visible Human male CT and fitted to this body's eyes and neck vertebrae.

systems.gaps: Approximate: traced automatically from 1 mm CT, without the parotid duct, facial nerve or internal lobes.

systems.label: Stomach (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: The stomach, traced from the Visible Human female CT and fitted to this body's liver, spleen, kidneys and pancreas.
supplied.male: The stomach, traced from the Visible Human male CT and fitted to this body's liver, spleen, kidneys and pancreas.

systems.gaps: Approximate outer surface only; no wall layers, folds or the gastro-oesophageal junction detail.

systems.label: Oesophagus (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: The oesophagus from the neck to the stomach, traced from the Visible Human female CT and fitted to this body's spine, lungs, heart and windpipe.
supplied.male: The oesophagus from the neck to the stomach, traced from the Visible Human male CT and fitted to this body's spine, lungs, heart and windpipe.

systems.gaps: Approximate outer surface only; no wall layers or sphincters.

systems.label: Thyroid gland (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: The thyroid gland, traced from the Visible Human female CT and fitted to this body's neck and chest.
supplied.male: The thyroid gland, traced from the Visible Human male CT and fitted to this body's neck and chest.

systems.gaps: Approximate; no parathyroid glands, lobes are not separated.

systems.label: Adrenal glands (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: Left and right adrenal glands, traced from the Visible Human female CT and fitted to this body's abdominal organs.
supplied.male: Left and right adrenal glands, traced from the Visible Human male CT and fitted to this body's abdominal organs.

systems.gaps: Approximate; small glands traced from CT, with no cortex or medulla.

systems.label: Ribs and costal cartilages (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: All 24 ribs and the costal cartilages, traced from the Visible Human female CT and fitted to this body's spine, lungs, heart and windpipe.
supplied.male: All 24 ribs and the costal cartilages, traced from the Visible Human male CT and fitted to this body's spine, lungs, heart and windpipe.

systems.gaps: Approximate; the body's lungs, from frozen sections, bulge slightly between the upper ribs.

systems.label: Sternum (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: The sternum, traced from the Visible Human female CT.
supplied.male: The sternum, traced from the Visible Human male CT.

systems.gaps: Approximate; its three parts are not separated.

systems.label: Gluteal muscles (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: Gluteus maximus, medius and minimus on both sides, traced from the Visible Human female CT and fitted to this body's hip bones, sacrum and lumbar spine.
supplied.male: Gluteus medius and minimus on both sides, traced from the Visible Human male CT. Gluteus maximus is left out: the male scan's first pass ends before the muscle does.

systems.gaps: Approximate outer surfaces; no tendons or attachments.

systems.label: Iliopsoas muscles (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: Left and right iliopsoas, traced from the Visible Human female CT and fitted to this body's hip bones, sacrum and lumbar spine.
supplied.male: Left and right iliopsoas, traced from the Visible Human male CT and fitted to this body's hip bones, sacrum and lumbar spine.

systems.gaps: Approximate; psoas and iliacus are not separated.

systems.label: Deep back muscles (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: The deep muscles along each side of the spine (erector spinae and transversospinalis groups), traced from the Visible Human female CT and fitted to this body's vertebrae.
supplied.male: The deep muscles along each side of the spine (erector spinae and transversospinalis groups), traced from the Visible Human male CT and fitted to this body's vertebrae.

systems.gaps: Approximate; the individual muscles of the group are not separated.

systems.label: Submandibular glands (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: Left and right submandibular glands, traced from the Visible Human female head CT and fitted to this body's eyes and neck vertebrae.
supplied.male: Not supplied: the traced male glands fell 26-43% outside this body's skin and were left out.

systems.gaps: Approximate outer surface; no submandibular duct or sublingual glands.

systems.label: Tongue (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: The tongue, traced from the Visible Human female head CT and fitted to this body's eyes and neck vertebrae.
supplied.male: The tongue, traced from the Visible Human male head CT and fitted to this body's eyes and neck vertebrae.

systems.gaps: Approximate outer surface; intrinsic and extrinsic muscles are not separated.

systems.label: Muscles of mastication (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: Masseter and medial and lateral pterygoid muscles on both sides, traced from the Visible Human female head CT and fitted to this body's eyes and neck vertebrae. Temporalis is left out: up to 22% fell outside this body's skin.
supplied.male: Masseter, temporalis and medial and lateral pterygoid muscles on both sides, traced from the Visible Human male head CT and fitted to this body's eyes and neck vertebrae.

systems.gaps: Approximate outer surfaces; no tendons or attachments to the skull, which these bodies lack.

systems.label: Mandible (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: The mandible, traced from the Visible Human female head CT and fitted to this body's eyes and neck vertebrae.
supplied.male: The mandible, traced from the Visible Human male head CT and fitted to this body's eyes and neck vertebrae.

systems.gaps: Approximate; no teeth, and the rest of the skull is not supplied.

systems.label: Neck muscles (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: Anterior, middle and posterior scalene muscles on both sides, traced from the Visible Human female CT. Sternocleidomastoid is left out: it fell partly outside this body's skin.
supplied.male: Anterior, middle and posterior scalene muscles on both sides, traced from the Visible Human male CT. Sternocleidomastoid is left out: it fell partly outside this body's skin.

systems.gaps: Approximate; the thin posterior scalenes are small fragments (about 1 cm3). Other neck muscles are not supplied.

systems.label: Pharyngeal constrictor muscles (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: The inferior pharyngeal constrictor, traced from the Visible Human female CT. The superior and middle constrictors traced only as fragments and are left out.
supplied.male: The inferior pharyngeal constrictor, traced from the Visible Human male CT. The superior and middle constrictors traced only as fragments and are left out.

systems.gaps: Approximate; the pharynx itself and its other muscles are not supplied.

systems.label: Hyoid bone (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: The hyoid bone, traced from the Visible Human female CT and fitted to this body's eyes and neck vertebrae.
supplied.male: Not supplied from CT: this body has its own hyoid bone.

systems.gaps: Approximate; the greater and lesser horns are not separated.

systems.label: Chest and back muscles (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: Serratus anterior and latissimus dorsi on both sides, traced from the Visible Human female CT and fitted to this body's spine, lungs, heart and windpipe. Pectoralis major (up to 24% outside the skin) and trapezius (traced only in fragments) are left out.
supplied.male: Pectoralis major, serratus anterior and latissimus dorsi on both sides, traced from the Visible Human male CT and fitted to this body's spine, lungs, heart and windpipe. Trapezius is left out: it traced only beside the spine.

systems.gaps: Approximate outer surfaces; edges are ragged where the CT sections join, and no tendons or attachments are supplied.

systems.label: Abdominal wall muscles (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: Rectus abdominis and external and internal oblique muscles on both sides, traced from the Visible Human female CT and fitted to this body's abdominal organs and lower spine.
supplied.male: Rectus abdominis and external and internal oblique muscles on both sides, traced from the Visible Human male CT and fitted to this body's abdominal organs and lower spine.

systems.gaps: Approximate; no transversus abdominis, rectus sheath or linea alba.

systems.label: Quadratus lumborum muscles (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: Left and right quadratus lumborum, traced from the Visible Human female CT and fitted to this body's vertebrae.
supplied.male: Left and right quadratus lumborum, traced from the Visible Human male CT and fitted to this body's vertebrae.

systems.gaps: Approximate outer surfaces; no attachments.

systems.label: Diaphragm (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: The diaphragm, taken from the Visible Human female CT as the sheet where the traced chest and abdominal cavities meet, and fitted to this body's abdominal organs.
supplied.male: The diaphragm, taken from the Visible Human male CT as the sheet where the traced chest and abdominal cavities meet, and fitted to this body's abdominal organs.

systems.gaps: Approximate: derived from the two cavities rather than traced directly, so its openings and crura are not shown. The body's lungs, from frozen sections, overlap it in places.

systems.label: Shoulder girdle (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: Left and right scapulae and clavicles, traced from the Visible Human female CT and placed by a per-side fit of the scan's skin around each shoulder to this body's skin.
supplied.male: Left and right scapulae and clavicles, traced from the Visible Human male CT and placed by a per-side fit of the scan's skin around each shoulder to this body's skin.

systems.gaps: Approximate: the shoulders are posed differently in the scan and the body, so placement follows the skin rather than the joints; the female clavicles overlap the body's lung apices.

systems.label: Upper-arm bones (Visible Human CT)

supplied.female: Left and right humeri, traced from the Visible Human female CT and placed by a per-side fit of the scan's skin around each shoulder to this body's skin.
supplied.male: Not supplied: the male scan's field of view cuts the humeri short.

systems.gaps: Approximate; placed by the skin rather than the shoulder or elbow joints, and the rest of the arm is not supplied.

systems.label: Other / unestablished coverage

supplied.female: No independent source grouping establishes additional system coverage in this catalogue.
supplied.male: No independent source grouping establishes additional system coverage in this catalogue.

systems.gaps: Independent endocrine coverage, microscopic tissues, complete anatomical layers, disease geometry and reviewed connections remain unestablished. Organs may occur in other source groups; absence of a separate grouping is not proof that every relevant mesh is missing.
